accepted_claims: Ferudun's Sigma(30,47,83) is a counterexample to the strong geography restriction over F2 for both orientations.
The total ungraded F2[U]-module HF-minus, summed over all Spin-c structures, has torsion length 16 and zero length-15 cyclic direct summands.
The example is an integral homology sphere with a unique Spin-c structure; there are 853 finite cyclic summands with total dimension 4864.

scope.spin_c: summed over every Spin-c structure; exactly one for this example

excluded_from_acceptance: Other coefficient fields or identical absolute gradings in both orientations.
External human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant verification.
published_theorem_dependencies: Nemethi 2005 almost-rational plumbing and graded-root theorems and Seifert formulas.
Can-Karakurt 2014 normalization, finite cutoff and semigroup description.
Ozsvath-Szabo 2004 plus/minus, HF-infinity and orientation-duality results.
publication_edition: Complete authored mathematical audit, acceptance/status/source-review wrappers and allowed public verification metadata.
